content.text:
The change belongs in [RankingList.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/ui/RankingList.svelte:35), which owns each row’s rank, identity, bar and declared amount. The rankings page only supplies formatted rows and category selection.

Two kinds of numbers appear:

- Ordinal positions (`1`, `2`, …) use `.rank`, currently `--text-small` (12px).
- Declared GBP amounts use `.value`, currently `--text-body` (14px).

The likely minimal change is to enlarge amounts to `var(--text-heading)` (22px) and give `.value` `align-self: end` so amounts sit beside the bar at the bottom of the identity column. If ordinal positions should also grow, update `.rank` separately.

The bars themselves are horizontal: `.bar-track` is a 3px-high track beneath the name and context. `li` currently uses `align-items: start`, explaining why the amount aligns with the name rather than vertically with the bar. `align-items: center` would center the whole value block against the entire identity block; it would not specifically align the amount with the bar. An “Incomplete” label can also shift the amount upward if bottom-aligning the whole `.value`; exact alignment in those rows would require explicit grid placement for amount, bar and status.

Keep this within the shared component rather than adding page CSS overrides. Preserve the narrow-screen behavior, where amounts move beneath the identity at widths ≤480px, and exact long amount wrapping.

Existing coverage:

- [rankings.spec.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/rankings.spec.ts:1): exact decimals, category switching, incomplete amounts, 320px overflow and reduced motion.
- [design-system.spec.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/design-system.spec.ts:482): gallery rendering, long amounts and reduced motion.

Neither currently asserts amount size or bar alignment.
